title: STEM for the Truckee community
intro: Snowbotics is more than a competition team. We want every kid in Truckee to see what hands-on science, technology, engineering and math can look like, so we take our robots out into the community and keep our team open to anyone who's curious.

photo.alt: Kids watching a Snowbotics robot demonstration at a community show

items.title: At community events
items.text: We bring our robots to local events, like the Truckee Maker Show at the Truckee Community Center, so people of all ages can see them up close.

items.title: Open to every student
items.text: Any Tahoe-Truckee High School student can join, along with incoming middle schoolers. No robotics experience is required.

items.title: Skills for what's next
items.text: Students learn CAD, Java programming, electrical systems and teamwork, hands-on skills that go well beyond robotics.
